editorial_contributions.text: The author posed several questions in [Geombinatorics 5, No. 3, 99-108 (1996; Zbl 0856.05036)]. In [Geombinatorics 9, No. 1, 10-20 (1999)] he responded to those questions dealing with the origins of definitions of the fractional chromatic number. In the present essay, he responds to questions about the fractional chromatic number of infinite graphs, with emphasis on the relation between the fractional chromatic number of the full graph and the fractional chromatic number of finite subgraphs. The author relies heavily on \textit{E. R. Scheinerman} and \textit{D. H. Ullman} [Fractional graph theory (John Wiley \& Sons, New York) (1997; Zbl 0891.05003)].
